name: player average box defenders per rush attempt pools over a year_offset range (executed-result parity)
description: Seed rush plays carrying box_defenders across 2024 (6, 7) and 2025 (9), plus a 2025 rush attempt whose box_defenders is NULL. The pooled average over the window is SUM(box_defenders) / COUNT(box_defenders) = 22/3 = 7.33 -- the NULL-reading attempt is a rush attempt but carries no reading, so it must not enter the denominator. The pre-repair declaration paired an AVG numerator with a rush-attempt denominator and recombines as SUM(per-year AVG) / SUM(attempts) = 15.5/4 = 3.875.
expected_query: with "t70447b5f0af51627f58187ca25b01e4e" as materialized (select COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid) as pid, SUM(CASE WHEN ball_carrier_pid IS NOT NULL THEN box_defenders ELSE 0 END) as average_box_defenders_per_rush_att_from_plays_numerator, SUM(CASE WHEN ball_carrier_pid IS NOT NULL AND box_defenders IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as average_box_defenders_per_rush_att_from_plays_denominator from "nfl_plays" where not "play_type" = 'NOPL' and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2024, 2025) group by COALESCE(ball_carrier_pid)) select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, (SELECT SUM(t70447b5f0af51627f58187ca25b01e4e.average_box_defenders_per_rush_att_from_plays_numerator) / NULLIF(SUM(t70447b5f0af51627f58187ca25b01e4e.average_box_defenders_per_rush_att_from_plays_denominator), 0) FROM t70447b5f0af51627f58187ca25b01e4e WHERE t70447b5f0af51627f58187ca25b01e4e.pid = player.pid) AS "average_box_defenders_per_rush_att_from_plays_0", "player"."primary_position" from "player" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
